description_en: Modifies a quality of service (QoS) policy, such as its name
description_zh: 修改QoS策略实例，支持修改QoS策略的名称
kebab_example: aliyun smartag modify-qos --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --qos-id qos-awfxl1adxeqyk0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyQos

parameters.help_en: The region where the QoS policy is deployed
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the QoS policy that you want to modify
parameters.help_zh: 需要修改的QoS策略的实例ID
parameters.name: qos_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the QoS policy
parameters.name: qos_name

parameters.help_en: The description of the QoS policy. The description must be 1 to 512 characters in length, and can contain digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-). It must start with a letter or Chinese character
parameters.help_zh: QoS策略描述，长度为1~512个字符，以大小写字母或中文开头，可包含数字、下划线（_)或短划线（-）
parameters.name: qos_description
